visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a bright blue puffer jacket, a black mask, and dark grey cargo pants enters the frame from behind a white door. He holds a light blue hair dryer by its cord and gestures toward his left eye with his free hand. In the background, a young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white cropped fluffy sweater and grey jeans, stands near a coffee table looking at her smartphone. (2) The woman puts her phone down and walks toward the man. She takes the hair dryer from him and proceeds to kneel on the wooden floor in front of him. She reaches up with both hands to adjust her hair, pulling it back. The man stands still, looking down at her while still holding one hand near his face. (3) The man looks slightly baffled and gestures toward the woman's head with the hair dryer. The woman remains in a kneeling position, looking up at him with a neutral expression. They engage in a brief dialogue with some hand gestures before the scene ends.
